characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

While the model is joined to a unit with at least one Full Rank, it gains Stand Behind.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Hard Target (1) and Skirmisher and loses Throwing Weapons (5+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Fey Rider gains Bastard Sword. The model gains Stubborn and counts as a Champion for the purpose of Issuing and Accepting Duels.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Fey Rider gains +1 Attack Value for each enemy model in base contact with it and its attacks ignore Parry.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Terror. The Fey Rider gains Lance and its attacks gain Multiple Wounds (2, against Towering Presence).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Folk Hero model part must choose at least 1 and up to 2 different Heroic Traits.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model may perform a Sweeping Attack. The enemy unit suffers 1 hit with Strength 1, Armour Penetration 0, and Magical Attacks. Enemy units suffering one or more hits with Grind Attacks or Sweeping Attacks from Friar's Lanterns suffer the following effects until the end of the next Player Turn:
  • -3" Advance Rate, to a minimum of 3"
  • -3" March Rate, to a minimum of 3"

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's Armour can never be improved beyond 5.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Unless Charging out of the unit, Characters joined to units with one or more Knights of the Courts gain Devastating Charge (+1" Adv).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Immediately after deploying the first friendly unit of Knights of the Quest during the Deployment Phase, the owner must choose 1 unit entry from the opponent’s Army Book (this may also be a Character, but not a Character Mount). Models of all units from this unit entry in the enemy army (even if there is more than one such unit) are considered “marked”. For attacks allocated either towards marked models, or towards models joined to units with more than half of their models marked, Questing Knights gain Lethal Strike and must reroll failed to-wound rolls.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Bodyguard (Duke, General with Sainted).In addition, the unit's Champion gains Knight Banneret for free, and the Knight Banneret Duplication Limit is increased to 0-3 Models with Knight Banneret per Army.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

A unit with at least one model with Vow of Redemption may never have more ranks than files. In addition, Folk Heroes with Cleric may join the unit and gain Unstable while joined to the unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute -- Shooting

During a Player Turn in which the model has not moved, if the model's unit has at least one Full Rank, the model gains two instances of Shoot in Extra Rank.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Enemy units in base contact with one or more models with Stalwart Defense do not count as Charging for the purpose of Devastating Charge.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's unit gains Magical Attacks and Strider (Forest).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model’s unit gains the following rules:
  • Fight in Extra Rank
  • The unit gains Minimised (Discipline Tests).
  • If the model’s unit is the target of an Orison while Engaged in Combat, add one Blessing Token to the owner’s Blessing Token pool. Ignore this effect if a Character with Faith is part of the model’s unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Catapult (4×4), Range 12--72", Shots 1, Str 5, AP 1. The model's Height is changed to Large.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Range 48", Shots 1, Str 3 [6], AP 10, [Multiple Wounds (D3, Clipped Wings)], Area Attack (1×5).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Gallantry (1). In addition, it is a Wizard Adept that does not select spells as normal, but instead must select 2 spells from:
  • Fountain of Youth (Druidism)
  • Entwining Roots (Druidism)
  • Raven's Wing (Witchcraft)
  • Twisted Effigy (Witchcraft)

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains The Blessing, Ordeal, and Shield and its Aegis can never be improved beyond Aegis (5+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's Health Points are set to 8, and its base size is changed to 75×100 SI. The model gains Maximised (Stomp Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Honesty and loses Ordeal and Shield. In addition, the Casting Value of friendly spells that target one or more friendly units within 12" of one or more Relic Bearers is reduced by 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Courage, Devastating Charge (+3 Str, +3 AP) and Light Armour, and loses Ordeal and Shield.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: At the start of step 7 of the Pre-Game Sequence (Spell Selection), add 1 Blessing Token to your Blessing Token pool for each unit with Holy Vows on your Army List.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--2 Models with Knight Banneret per Army.


The model gains the following rules:


  • The model gains +1 Health Point, up to a maximum of 3.

  • The model may take a single Banner Enchantment from this Army Book, for which it is considered to have a Special Item allowance with no limit.

  • When calculating Combat Score, the model adds +1 to its side’s Combat Score.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
At the start of each friendly Magic Phase, you may apply the following rules to each unit containing one or more models with Ordo Minister:

  • The unit, or a model inside the unit, may Raise 1 Health Point.
  • In order to Raise a Health Point of a Champion or Character, 1 Blessing Token has to be removed from the owner's Blessing Token pool.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: During Army List creation, the unit gains a Gallantry value that corresponds to the value stated in brackets (X). Multiple instances of Gallantry (X) on the same model are cumulative, but multiple instances in the same unit do not stack. The sum of the Gallantry values of all units on the Army List is restricted to 1 per 650 Army Points, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
0--3 Units/Army.

When deploying the unit, you may place a Wall Terrain Feature fully within 1" of the unit's Front Facing but not in contact with any other Terrain Feature except Open Terrain. This Wall is up to 1" deep and its length cannot exceed the width of the unit, up to a maximum of 12". It follows the normal rules for Walls, with the exception that it contributes to Soft Cover instead of Hard Cover.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One of a Kind. Cannot be taken by the Battle Standard Bearer.

Model parts without Harnessed gain Fearless and +1 Attack Value.
In addition, the model is always under the effect of Orison of Shielding, Orison of Striking, and Orison of Discipline. This does not prevent the model’s unit from being the target of an Orison, but the model does not benefit from this additional Orison.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Aegis (5+) with the following restriction: The effect can only be used against wounds against which the model cannot take or would automatically fail its Armour Save.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Aegis (5+, against Magical Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Aegis (5+) while its unit is Engaged in the same Combat as at least one other friendly unit. In addition, Characters may join a unit containing one or more Insignificant R&F models with Commonfolk even if they aren't Insignificant themselves and gain Insignificant while joined to the unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Hand Weapon. Attacks made with a Bastard Sword gain +1 Strength and Devastating Charge (+1 AP).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Unless making a Stand and Shoot Charge Reaction, the model gains Accurate if it did not move during this Player Turn.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model becomes the Battle Standard Bearer.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model is a Wizard Adept that chooses Witchcraft as its Path of Magic.
If on foot, the model gains Scout.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Musician and is a Wizard Apprentice that chooses Divination as its Path of Magic.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Clergy, Ordo Minister, Holy Vows, and loses Commonfolk.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part gains +2 Attack Value and Commanding Presence (6", Commonfolk).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part gains Lethal Strike. In addition, Duels issued by the model must (if possible) be accepted by an enemy Character, unless a Champion accepts first. While fighting a Duel, the model part's Close Combat Attacks that rolled a natural ‘6’ to wound gain Multiple Wounds (2).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While using a Shield, the model gains Distracting.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Attached and Exclusive (R&F model). R&F models with Nobility in the unit that the model is deployed in gain Bastard Sword and Weapon Master until the end of the game.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Whenever another model in the model's unit suffers an unsaved wound due to an enemy Melee Attack (including Initiative Step 0), the model part must perform a single Close Combat Attack at Initiative Step 0 against an enemy model in base contact. If this is not possible, the effect is ignored. The number of these bonus attacks that the model part performs can never be higher than 3 per Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Fearless and the model part's Close Combat Attacks gain Multiple Wounds (2, against Fear).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model's unit gains Maximised (Charge Range).
In addition, while Engaged with an enemy unit's Front Facing, the model part gains Devastating Charge (+2 Att).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Fearless and Holy Vows. In addition, if the model's unit is the target of an Orison while Engaged in Combat, add one Blessing Token to the owner's Blessing Token pool.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Unit profiles in this Army Book contain an additional Characteristic, which corresponds to the units' Aegis Saves, shortened Aeg. This Characteristic is treated as if the unit has the Personal Protection Aegis (X+) written on its profile, where X is the Aeg Characteristic value. Not having an Aeg value does not prevent a unit from being the target of an Aegis modifier.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Each Kingdom of Equitaine army has a pool of Blessing Tokens that can never contain more than 6 tokens. In each Magic Phase, immediately after Siphon the Veil, Blessing Tokens can be discarded. For every discarded Blessing Token, choose a single friendly unit and apply one of the following effects until the start of the next Magic Phase:


  • Orison of Shielding: The unit gains Aegis (5+).

  • Orison of Striking: Model parts without Harnessed in the unit gain +1 to hit with Close Combat Attacks and their Close Combat Attacks become Magical Attacks.

  • Orison of Discipline: The unit's Discipline is set to 9.

A single unit can only be the target of one Orison per Player Turn, unless specifically stated otherwise.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Fight in Extra Rank. In addition, if the model is Standard, it gains Extra Support (2). If more than half of a unit’s models have Lance Formation and the unit is 3 or 4 models wide, it counts as being in Line Formation and only needs to be 3 models wide in order to form Full Ranks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Add ⟨one Blessing Token⟩ {two Blessing Tokens} to your Blessing Token pool.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: After the wielder completes a Charge, attacks made with this weapon gain +2 Strength and +2 Armour Penetration  until the wielder is no longer Engaged in Combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While using this weapon, the wielder gains +1 Attack Value, and attacks made with this weapon  gain +1 Armour Penetration. After a successful to-hit roll, the attacker may discard one of the hits with this weapon and choose an enchanted weapon carried by the model the attack was allocated towards. Any Weapon Enchantment of the chosen weapon is ignored for the rest of the game, even if the bearer is removed as a casualty.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Once per Round of Combat, unless fighting a Duel, after one or more successful to-hit rolls made with this weapon against an enemy model, the target's unit suffers 1 hit with Area Attack (1×5) in the same Initiative Step as the initial Close Combat Attack. The hits from the Area Attack have the same Strength, Armour Penetration, and Attack Attributes as the initial Close Combat Attack. This is considered a Special Attack.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wielder gains Fear and Terror. Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour and Aegis (+1, max. 4+).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: While using this Shield, the bearer gains +1 Armour while its unit contains at least one R&F model.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Fear while Engaged in Combat. Enemy units in base contact with the bearer’s unit cannot benefit from Rally Around the Flag.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit gains Devastating Charge (Aegis (5+)). In addition, enemy units cannot choose Stand and Shoot as a Charge Reaction against Charges declared by the bearer's unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit may reroll failed Dicipline Tests. The Battle Standard Bearer gains Rally Around the Flag (18", max. 18") while it is part of the bearer's unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. May be activated immediately before declaring a Charge with the bearer or the bearer’s unit in the Charge Phase. Failed Charge Range rolls of the bearer or the bearer’s unit must be rerolled until the end of the phase. Other Characters Charging out of the bearer’s unit are not affected.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer can cast Breath of the Lady (Hereditary Spell) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Magic Resistance (1). When the bearer’s unit is the target of an enemy Casting Attempt, including Attribute Spells, the bearer’s owner gains 1 Veil Token.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: One use only. The first time the bearer’s model suffers an unsaved wound from an attack with Multiple Wounds (X), the model gains Immune (Multiple Wounds (X)) until the end of the phase.
